perAssetNotes.LIFE-008: Keep independent interior master. Create a separate honest reference presentation assembly using real legacy006 cabinet and007 doors; clothes/boxes must be actual contextual geometry, not part of the008 count. Verify interior installation against actual cabinet occupancy.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-009: Bevelled wood frame, detailed metal/brass corners and pivot brackets, fine drawer reveal, existing dedicated mirrorGlass137 as opaque environment-reflective backing. No claim of planar scene reflection unless actually implemented.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-019: Bevelled differentiated keycaps, wood grain direction, metal base edge, real cable and rotary knob; keys polymer, display indicators optical roles. Preserve keyboard clear gaps.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-020: Real two-segment continuous diagonal arms and axle brackets within original nominal envelope; bevelled lantern shade, separate translucent diffuser and actual luminous core, explicit author preview light.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-023: Continuous circular wood rim and padded seat, four bevelled tapered legs, lower stretchers, discrete metal/brass brackets; fabric stitching may use real exported texture.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-024: Reference has two tilted shoe drawers. Need explicit reference-open pose alongside closed usable configuration, real hinge axis, interior shelf/shoes contextual. Preserve original nominal cabinet footprint and mark open envelope separately.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-025: Bevelled shelf and bracket fasteners; any books/plant remain genuine separate context assets, not new masters or hidden parts of shelf.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-026: Two continuous extruded rails with actual slot/channel, individual minimum block hangers, dark metal, stone end housings and brass caps.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-027: Continuous curved folds, real cloth thickness/hem, cloth-purpose woven border texture and motif, independent hanging loops; reference rail in separate presentation assembly.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-028: Review underside from suitable camera; separate thin light diffuser, housing, actual light core and recessed corner fasteners. Keep mounting surface and service back distinct.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-029: Continuous bracket, brass/wood frame, actual thin diffuser walls and internal luminous core; geometric motif or fabric/ink material as appropriate, no emissive-solid fake glass.
perAssetNotes.LIFE-030: Native bolt/block details with bevelled panel, real socket holes, separate rocker/display optical surfaces; wall anchor and back box retained.
